messages:
liam_sales: Quick sales-to-CS pass for Nimbus Health. Contract signed last Thurs. ARR equivalent ~50k/mo token volume. They require SSO + private VPC and want audit logs in retention window. Start-of-onboarding planned for Mon 2024-04-15. Renewal cadence: annual (11mo till renewal).

liam_sales: Risk context: onboarding already delayed twice due to security checklist items; legal asked about subprocessors and data residency. If we don't hit early wins, renewal sentiment may soften. Flagging medium-high risk. :warning:

maya_cs: Got it, I'll take ownership. Liam, can you drop the signed SOW and the security answers in this thread? Need them for kickoff packet.

liam_sales: Done: <https://drive.redwood/teams/nimbus/sow.pdf> and security-qa doc linked. There's a comment from legal re: subprocessor list to resolve.

kevin_eng: I'll own SSO connector and private VPC setup. Requirements: customer IdP metadata (SAML/OIDC), egress IP allowlist, and approximate dataset size for provisioning. When can they provide?

maya_cs: I'll request IdP metadata in the kickoff invite. Can Kevin join Tue 4/16 10:00-10:30 PT for the tech kickoff?

kevin_eng: Yes, 10:00-10:30 PT works. Also need expected peak sequence length and any heavy-IO data stores so we size caching and disk.

maya_cs: Nimbus shared preliminary numbers: dataset ~120GB, peak seq length ~4k tokens. Adding that to agenda.

shreya_enablement: I'll deliver enablement for their devs: 60m session covering platform basics, token cost patterns, caching best practices, and private deployment caveats. Will include a short dev checklist. Maya, do you want this in week after kickoff?

maya_cs: Yes please. Target Wed 4/24 for enablement. Also proposing weekly 15m status syncs on Mondays and a dedicated ops channel for quick escalations.

liam_sales: Note: customer mentioned interest in dedicated capacity later in the year. Keep as upsell opportunity. I'll remain on standby for any contract/legal escalation. :memo:

maya_cs: Action owners summarized: Maya = onboarding lead + weekly sync; Kevin = SSO/VPC runbook + infra tasks; Shreya = enablement deck + checklist; Liam = deal/legal escalation. I'll open Jira tickets and link artifacts.

maya_cs: Eng question: do we have a standard private VPC runbook template to share with customers? They asked to review our network flow and audit process to satisfy their security team.

kevin_eng: We do. I'll attach the runbook and a network diagram to the Jira card. Also note: for private deploy we may need to coordinate a brief maintenance window for initial warmup.

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Nimbus Health kickoff" scheduled 2024-04-16 10:00 PT. Jira ticket CS-4982 created and assigned to maya_cs, kevin_eng, shreya_enablement.

maya_cs: Thanks, I'll capture onboarding feedback in the enablement session and create a one-pager for Product if there are platform gaps.

liam_sales: Confirming I'll join the kickoff for intros. Please escalate legal subprocessor question to me and I will coordinate with contracts.

maya_cs: Short next-steps: 1) Maya to request IdP metadata + confirm dataset details by EOD 4/12; 2) Kevin to attach runbook + network diagram to CS-4982 by 4/15; 3) Shreya to draft enablement deck by 4/20; 4) Kickoff 4/16 10am PT. I'll update weekly sync invite after kickoff.

maya_cs: tagging owners @kevin_eng @shreya_enablement @liam_sales  please confirm and flag blockers.
